description: the libraries of gait styles of soma: each file is read by soma.gaits.load(url); a creature takes a style by its name: legs: { gait: { from: name } }

libraries.name: accubvh
libraries.description: The gait styles of the walk takes of the EyesJapan motion capture as BVH files of D:\work\accu\bvh (azumi, takiguchi and yokoyama, the joints' turns retargeted onto the ActorCore skeleton), 36 styles from the walks and runs, read through the ActorCore skeleton (ActorCore_Dummy.glb) by soma's own person import (tools/clip_scan.js's reading, tools/clip_collect.js's ranges): how fast the body goes, how long a step is, how much of a cycle a foot is in the air, how high it lifts, how far the hips bob, when each limb steps, the foot's path and roll and the upper body, in the units of the person (leg lengths, hips' heights, shares of a cycle). Where each comes from: accubvh.sources.json. Made by soma/tools/clip_import/accubvh/.

libraries.name: cmu

A creature takes one with gaits: [{ from: name }]; the numbers are made its own by its legs. Made by soma/tools/gait_tool.js from the loops of soma/tools/bvh_tool.js.

libraries.name: normal_stable
libraries.description: Normal, stable walks of a person, copied from the other libraries: 26 styles chosen from the 438 two-legged person styles of those libraries that walk at 1.15 to 1.75 leg lengths a second (1.0 to 1.5 m/s on the person's 0.86 m legs). Each of the 438 was walked for 6 s on soma's person in the lab and measured, the best 130 were walked again for 8 s and measured with the worker's own frame clock, and a style is kept here when it reaches its own pace and never leaves the floor, steps alike with both legs, does not sink a sole into the floor or let a planted foot skate, does not lurch (the head's acceleration, sway and bob stay small, the bob at 4 cm or less), keeps the trunk upright and quiet, lifts the foot 5 to 15 cm, holds no prop, keeps both hands hanging by the hips (none held up) and swings the arms 10 to 55 cm. A style here is the library style of the same name without the 'normal_' in front, copied as it is (the numbers, the feet, the upper body). A creature takes one with legs: { gait: { from: name } }.

Each of the 369 was walked for 6 s on soma's person (0.86 m legs) in the lab and measured, the best 121 were walked again for 8 s and measured with the worker's own frame clock, and a style is kept here when it walks at 0.60 m/s or under, takes real steps (0.28 m or more, 1.9 a second at most), is on both feet more than 55 % of the time and never in the air, does not lurch (the head's acceleration, sway and bob stay small), keeps the trunk upright and quiet, steps alike with both legs, does not sink a sole into the floor or let a planted foot skate, holds no prop and keeps the hands hanging by the hips. A style here is the library style of the same name without the 'slow_' in front, copied as it is (the numbers, the feet, the upper body). A creature takes one with legs: { gait: { from: name } }.
